messages:
nora: quick thread before tomorrow's roadmap sync — drafting the end-to-end acceptance path for multi-region tenant slicing. want to lock the minimal must-haves.
elen: high level: product needs a short customer-facing checklist + an internal launch gate list. sales wants a one-line guidance per gate.
hafiz: infra constraints: we should quantify packing inefficiency for each policy class (isolated/affinity/shared). short table in doc will do.
jack: ops: require an evacuation dry-run in staging with recorded error metrics. target: <2% failed requests during cutover window.
elen: propose minimal customer gates: automated deploy + evacuation test, agreed latency SLOs, console cost projection shown, fallback policy consent, reserved-commit terms, signed residency addendum.
hafiz: router knobs to expose: prefer_region, allow_fallbacks (bool), fallback_sequence (list), max_cost_uplift_pct, reserved_commit_days. default allow_fallbacks=true.
jack: rollout phasing: internal -> 2 invited customers -> small cohort (<=10) -> GA. metric gates at each phase. include rollback criteria.
legal-bot: reminder: jurisdictional isolation triggers DPA addendum and egress controls. legal review required before GA.
elen: quality guardrails: define prompt-set + pass thresholds (regression delta <=5% for GA, pilot may allow up to 8% with acceptance).
hafiz: telemetry to collect in pilot: token_cost_usd, kv_cache_hit_rate, chosen_model_variant, fallback_reason, sequence_length_p95. will wire to Optimize.
nora: commercial note: product to draft a simple uplift band table and an example calc for sales. if uplift > 18% recommend reserved discount path.
jack: action items: hafiz to add cost delta examples to the roadmap doc (Tue), elen to draft sales one-pager (Thu), ops to schedule staging evacuation dry-run (Fri).
file_note: onramp governance / launch gates for multi-region tenant slicing
